claims.claim: It is a large, full colour, laser multifunctional printer.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a large office copier with Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e text on the front label.
Photo 0 front label reads bizhub PRO C754e, not C854e.

risks.proof: Video of the machine powering on and reaching a ready state.

risks.risk: Whether it prints, copies, or scans correctly.
risks.proof: Video of a test print, copy, and scan with output shown.
risks.if_unproven: as not functional for core tasks

risks.proof: Photo or screenshot of the control panel showing the meter count.

risks.risk: Condition of drums, toner, or other consumables.
risks.proof: Screenshot of consumable status or close-up showing remaining drum and toner life.

risks.risk: Whether all paper trays and feeders work.
risks.proof: Video of each tray and feeder successfully feeding paper.
risks.if_unproven: as trays or feeders may be faulty

risks.risk: Any error codes or service history.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the error log or service records.
risks.if_unproven: as possible hidden faults or missing service history

risks.risk: Whether cables or power cord are included.
risks.proof: Photo of the included power cord and cables.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and making a test copy
Photo of the control panel meter reading
Photo of the power cord and cables included
Screenshot of consumable status and error log
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e from the front label, so a worst-case price is possible; the seller's C854e claim is contradicted and functionality is unproven.
